checks.label: Vital signs (BP, pulse, temperature, SpO2)
checks.whyItMatters: Vitals anchor triage priority and escalation decisions.

checks.label: Symptom duration / timeline
checks.whyItMatters: Onset and duration change the urgency of the review.

checks.label: Current medications and allergies
checks.whyItMatters: Needed before any clinician decision; this system never advises medication.

checks.label: Relevant past history
checks.whyItMatters: Existing conditions shape how urgently the patient should be seen.

checks.label: Age of the patient
checks.whyItMatters: Age band influences how urgently the patient should be reviewed.

checks.label: Sex / gender
checks.whyItMatters: Recorded for the reviewing clinician; never a clinical judgement.

checks.label: Weight
checks.whyItMatters: Weight is needed for accurate vital assessment by the clinician.

checks.label: Pregnancy status
checks.whyItMatters: Changes which workflow pathway a clinician should follow.

checks.label: Pain severity (self-reported)
checks.whyItMatters: A self-reported severity helps the reviewer judge urgency.

checks.label: Associated symptoms
checks.whyItMatters: Additional reported symptoms change how the case is reviewed.

checks.label: Recent travel / exposure
checks.whyItMatters: Exposure history is a workflow input for the reviewing clinician.

checks.label: Immunisation status
checks.whyItMatters: Recorded for the reviewer; this system never advises treatment.

checks.label: Smoking / alcohol use
checks.whyItMatters: Lifestyle history is part of a complete review record.

checks.label: Family history
checks.whyItMatters: Family history helps the clinician contextualise the case.

checks.label: Current condition / stability
checks.whyItMatters: A reported trend helps the reviewer prioritise the case.

checks.label: Feeding / appetite
checks.whyItMatters: Reported intake is a workflow input for the reviewing clinician.

checks.label: Bowel / bladder habits
checks.whyItMatters: Reported habits complete the record for the reviewer.

checks.label: Rash / skin changes
checks.whyItMatters: A reported skin change is part of the observational record.

checks.label: Injury mechanism
checks.whyItMatters: How an injury happened helps the reviewer judge urgency.

checks.label: Prior treatment / consultation
checks.whyItMatters: Prior care is part of a complete handover record.
